WITH matching_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name = 'Autoloader.PPal'
    AND subsystem = 'Vacuum'
    AND component = 'Autoloader'
)

SELECT
  time,
  value AS "PPal pressure"
FROM unnest(
  (
    SELECT lttb(
      time,
      value_num,
      2 * (($__to - $__from) / $__interval_ms)::int
    )
    FROM data
    WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
      AND param_id = (SELECT param_id FROM matching_param)
      AND $__timeFilter(time)
  )
)
ORDER BY time;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('Autoloader', 'X', 'X.MaxControllerOut'),
    ('Autoloader', 'X', 'X.SettlingDuration'),
    ('Autoloader', 'X', 'X.MaxPositionError'),
    ('Autoloader', 'X', 'X.PositionError')
  ) AS t(subsystem, component, param_name)
),

label_map AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('X.MaxControllerOut', 'Max Controller Output'),
    ('X.SettlingDuration', 'Settling Duration'),
    ('X.MaxPositionError', 'Motion Error'),
    ('X.PositionError', 'Position Error')
  ) AS lm(param_name, label)
),

matching_params AS (
  SELECT p.param_id, p.param_name
  FROM parameters p
  JOIN params t
    ON p.subsystem = t.subsystem
   AND p.component = t.component
   AND p.param_name = t.param_name
  WHERE p.instrument_id = $instrument
),

raw_values AS (
  SELECT
    d.time,
    p.param_name,
    d.value_num
  FROM data d
  JOIN matching_params p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
),

agg_values AS (
  SELECT
    param_name,
    MIN(value_num) AS raw_min,
    MAX(value_num) AS raw_max,
    AVG(value_num) AS raw_avg,
    STDDEV(value_num) AS raw_stdev
  FROM raw_values
  GROUP BY param_name
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(lm.label, av.param_name) AS parameter,
  CASE
    WHEN av.param_name ~* 'Position' THEN
      CASE
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'min'   THEN av.raw_min   * 1000
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'max'   THEN av.raw_max   * 1000
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'avg'   THEN av.raw_avg   * 1000
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'stdev' THEN av.raw_stdev * 1000
      END
    ELSE
      CASE
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'min'   THEN av.raw_min
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'max'   THEN av.raw_max
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'avg'   THEN av.raw_avg
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'stdev' THEN av.raw_stdev
      END
  END AS value
FROM agg_values av
LEFT JOIN label_map lm ON av.param_name = lm.param_name
ORDER BY parameter;

SELECT

WITH matching_params AS (
  SELECT param_id, display_name
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'KriosTemperatures'
    AND param_name IN ('TSample', 'Tcldwr', 'Taldwr', 'Tdocker', 'Tcassette', 'Tcartridge')
)

SELECT
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '$__interval', d.time) AS time,
  p.display_name,
  AVG(d.value_num) AS temperature
FROM data d
JOIN matching_params p
  ON d.param_id = p.param_id
WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  AND d.value_num != 0
GROUP BY time, p.display_name
ORDER BY time;

WITH matching_params AS (
  SELECT param_id, param_name
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'KriosTemperatures'
    AND param_name IN ('TSample', 'Tcldwr', 'Taldwr', 'Tdocker', 'Tcassette', 'Tcartridge')
)

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Count",
  MAX(d.time) AS "Last outlier"
FROM data d
JOIN matching_params p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  AND (d.value_num < 70 OR d.value_num > 310);

panels.description:
1) Max CRT temperature after cassette load. Time window is 3 min before cassette load counter event
2) Avg temperature increase during load. Same time window
3) Avg temperature recovery shows the difference between the CRT temperature 10 min after loading and the min temperature before loading. Values close to 0 indicate optimal recovery

matcher.options: Avg CRT temperature increase during load
Avg temperature recovery 10 min after load

targets.rawSql:
WITH 
-- Get parameter IDs
counter_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name = 'LoadCassetteCounter'
),
temperature_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name = 'Tcartridge'
),

-- Detect counter increments (cassette load events)
counter_events AS (
  SELECT
    d.time AS event_time,
    d.value_num,
    LAG(d.value_num) OVER (ORDER BY d.time) AS prev_value
  FROM data d
  JOIN counter_param p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
),

-- Keep only the last 10 increment events
load_events AS (
  SELECT event_time
  FROM (
    SELECT event_time
    FROM counter_events
    WHERE prev_value IS NOT NULL AND value_num > prev_value
    ORDER BY event_time DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) sub
),

-- Pre-event temperature data (-3min to 0min)
pre_window AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_time,
    t.value_num AS temperature
  FROM load_events l
  JOIN data t ON t.instrument_id = $instrument
  JOIN temperature_param tp ON t.param_id = tp.param_id
  WHERE t.time BETWEEN l.event_time - INTERVAL '3 minutes' AND l.event_time
),

-- Final result per event (with post +10 min temp via LATERAL)
event_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_time,
    MIN(p.temperature) AS temp_min_pre,
    MAX(p.temperature) AS temp_max_pre,
    MAX(p.temperature) - MIN(p.temperature) AS temp_diff_pre,
    post.temperature_at_plus10,
    post.temperature_at_plus10 - MIN(p.temperature) AS delta_temp_plus10_minus_min_pre
  FROM load_events l
  LEFT JOIN pre_window p ON l.event_time = p.event_time
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT t.value_num AS temperature_at_plus10
    FROM data t
    JOIN temperature_param tp ON t.param_id = tp.param_id
    WHERE t.instrument_id = $instrument
      AND t.time >= l.event_time + INTERVAL '10 minutes'
    ORDER BY t.time
    LIMIT 1
  ) post ON TRUE
  GROUP BY l.event_time, post.temperature_at_plus10
)

-- Final aggregated summary
SELECT
  MAX(temp_max_pre) AS "Max T after cassette load",
  AVG(temp_diff_pre) AS "Avg T increase during load",
  AVG(delta_temp_plus10_minus_min_pre) AS "Avg T recovery 10 min after load"
FROM event_metrics;

targets.rawSql:
WITH state_param AS (
  SELECT
    param_id,
    enum_id
  FROM
    parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name = 'AutoloaderTemperatureState'
    AND subsystem = 'AutoloaderTemperatureControl'
),
state_enum AS (
  SELECT
    p.param_id,
    e.value AS cryocycle
  FROM
    state_param p
    JOIN enum_values e ON e.enum_id = p.enum_id
  WHERE
    e.member_name = 'CryoCycle'
),
autoloader_states AS (
  SELECT
    sp.param_id,
    st.state,
    st.start_time,
    st.end_time
  FROM
    state_param sp
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT
        state,
        start_time,
        end_time
      FROM
        state_int_timeline(
          (
            SELECT
              state_agg(d.time, d.value_num :: bigint)
            FROM
              data d
            WHERE
              d.instrument_id = $instrument
              AND d.param_id = sp.param_id
          )
        )
    ) AS st
)

  SELECT
    r.start_time,
    r.end_time,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(r.end_time - r.start_time)) AS total_duration
  FROM
    autoloader_states r
    JOIN state_enum se USING (param_id)
  WHERE
    r.state = se.cryocycle
    AND (r.end_time - r.start_time) > INTERVAL '0 second'
  ORDER BY
    r.start_time

WITH matching_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'TempCtrl'
    AND param_name = 'Laldwr'
),

bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('30 seconds', d.time) AS bucket,
    AVG(d.value_num) AS avg_value
  FROM data d
  JOIN matching_param p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  GROUP BY bucket
),

lagged AS (
  SELECT
    bucket,
    avg_value,
    LAG(avg_value, 1) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS val_1,
    LAG(avg_value, 2) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS val_2,
    LAG(avg_value, 3) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS val_3
  FROM bucketed
),

labeled AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN avg_value > 90 AND (val_1 < 90 OR val_1 IS NULL) THEN true
      WHEN avg_value >= COALESCE(val_1, -1e9)
       AND avg_value >= COALESCE(val_2, -1e9)
       AND avg_value >= COALESCE(val_3, -1e9)
       AND avg_value > 90 THEN true
      ELSE false
    END AS is_peak
  FROM lagged
),

with_peak_groups AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN is_peak AND NOT LAG(is_peak, 1, false) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS new_peak_start
  FROM labeled
),

peak_groups AS (
  SELECT *,
    SUM(new_peak_start) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS peak_group_id
  FROM with_peak_groups
),

ranked_peaks AS (
  SELECT
    bucket AS time,
    avg_value,
    peak_group_id,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY peak_group_id ORDER BY avg_value DESC) AS val_rank
  FROM peak_groups
  WHERE is_peak
),

collapsed_peaks AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    avg_value AS value,
    'Refill' AS type
  FROM ranked_peaks
  WHERE val_rank = 1
),

raw_values AS (
  SELECT
    bucket AS time,
    avg_value AS value,
    'LN level' AS type
  FROM bucketed
)

SELECT * FROM raw_values
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM collapsed_peaks
ORDER BY time;

WITH matching_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'TempCtrl'
    AND param_name = 'Laldwr'
),

bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('30 seconds', d.time) AS bucket,
    AVG(d.value_num) AS avg_value
  FROM data d
  JOIN matching_param p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  GROUP BY bucket
),

lagged AS (
  SELECT
    bucket,
    avg_value,
    LAG(avg_value, 1) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS val_1,
    LAG(avg_value, 2) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS val_2,
    LAG(avg_value, 3) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS val_3
  FROM bucketed
),

labeled AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN avg_value > 90 AND (val_1 < 90 OR val_1 IS NULL) THEN true
      WHEN avg_value >= COALESCE(val_1, -1e9)
       AND avg_value >= COALESCE(val_2, -1e9)
       AND avg_value >= COALESCE(val_3, -1e9)
       AND avg_value > 90 THEN true
      ELSE false
    END AS is_peak
  FROM lagged
),

with_peak_groups AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN is_peak AND NOT LAG(is_peak, 1, false) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS new_peak_start
  FROM labeled
),

peak_groups AS (
  SELECT *,
    SUM(new_peak_start) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS peak_group_id
  FROM with_peak_groups
),

ranked_peaks AS (
  SELECT
    bucket AS time,
    avg_value,
    peak_group_id,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY peak_group_id ORDER BY avg_value DESC) AS val_rank
  FROM peak_groups
  WHERE is_peak
),

collapsed_peaks AS (
  SELECT time
  FROM ranked_peaks
  WHERE val_rank = 1
),

with_deltas AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    LAG(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_time
  FROM collapsed_peaks
),

deltas AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - prev_time)) AS sec_between
  FROM with_deltas
  WHERE prev_time IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT AVG(sec_between) AS avg_sec_between_refills
FROM deltas;

WITH state_param AS (
  SELECT
    param_id,
    enum_id
  FROM
    parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name = 'AutoloaderTemperatureState'
    AND subsystem = 'AutoloaderTemperatureControl'
),

state_enum AS (
  SELECT
    p.param_id,
    e.value AS cryocycle
  FROM
    state_param p
    JOIN enum_values e ON e.enum_id = p.enum_id
  WHERE
    e.member_name = 'CryoCycle'
),

autoloader_states AS (
  SELECT
    sp.param_id,
    st.state,
    st.start_time,
    st.end_time
  FROM
    state_param sp
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT
        state,
        start_time,
        end_time
      FROM
        state_int_timeline(
          (
            SELECT
              state_agg(d.time, d.value_num :: bigint)
            FROM
              data d
            WHERE
              d.instrument_id = $instrument
              AND d.param_id = sp.param_id
          )
        )
    ) AS st
),

last_cryo AS (
  SELECT
    r.end_time AS cryo_end_time
  FROM
    autoloader_states r
    JOIN state_enum se USING (param_id)
  WHERE
    r.state = se.cryocycle
    AND (r.end_time - r.start_time) > INTERVAL '0 second'
  ORDER BY r.end_time DESC
  LIMIT 1
),

cassette_counter_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name = 'LoadCassetteCounter'
),

baseline AS (
  SELECT d.value_num AS baseline_val
  FROM data d
  JOIN cassette_counter_param ccp ON d.param_id = ccp.param_id
  JOIN last_cryo lc ON true
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND d.time <= lc.cryo_end_time
  ORDER BY d.time DESC
  LIMIT 1
),

after_cryo AS (
  SELECT MAX(d.value_num) AS max_val
  FROM data d
  JOIN cassette_counter_param ccp ON d.param_id = ccp.param_id
  JOIN last_cryo lc ON true
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND d.time >= lc.cryo_end_time
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(a.max_val, b.baseline_val) - COALESCE(b.baseline_val, 0) AS cassette_loads_since_cryocycle
FROM baseline b
CROSS JOIN after_cryo a;
